citations.title: Interview: a team lead reports that budget caps stopped an overrun

counterEvidence.note: Every committed pattern-bundle manifest records policy.budget.enforcement: none; no runtime component reads or enforces a token, money, time or rate budget. The interview describes retry.maxAttempts stopping the overrun, not a budget.
